en.problem: Boards and councils spend hours turning each session into formal minutes, and every organization has its own structure and language for them.
en.solution: Built a SaaS on React and hapi.js/Node.js on AWS with AI transcription of sessions and LLM agents that draft the minutes following each organization's structure and language. Added role- and privilege-based access, SQL migrations and AWS Cognito authentication.
en.result: Used by multiple organizations to run the full lifecycle of their minutes: drafting, review, approval and archival. [TODO: métrica]
